capabilities: Render the vault graph as a live 3D constellation
Fly spacecraft through the graph in Pilot mode
Dock at note planets and fight bots or players on their surfaces
Join private multiplayer rooms over WebRTC
Search, select and open notes from the graph
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.7.2+ and WebGL. Free, no accounts. Archived 0.7.1-and-older builds retain the old constellation-graph plugin ID and warn they must not be installed over JusVibin's original plugin; from 0.7.2 the fork uses its own 'citizen' ID and settings are not migrated automatically.
intentEvidence: Citizen is J117W3's fork of Constellation Graph by JusVibin.
motivation: The author forked Constellation Graph to take it in a new direction as a playable space and surface sandbox built around a private note constellation.
problem: Obsidian's Graph view is a static map; there is no built-in way to fly through the note constellation in 3D, play in it, or share a live view with friends.

relations.evidence: Citizen is J117W3's fork of Constellation Graph by JusVibin.

requires.name: ntfy relay, STUN/TURN services and a Cloudflare Worker (multiplayer only)

summary: Turns the vault graph into a 3D constellation you can fly through, with optional private multiplayer flight and first-person combat on planets.
